messages.subject: Project Lumen - proposed compromise on key SPA terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Margaret, Priya,

Hargrove have come back hard on the SPA. Subject to your sign-off, we propose to settle as follows:

- Warrantor cap: 75% of the Investment Amount (they asked for 50%, we drafted 100%).
- Survival: 15 months (they asked for 12).
- Founder non-compete: 18 months (we drafted 24).
- De minimis 17.5% of the Threshold; Threshold GBP 150,000.
- MAC condition: we recommend holding it unqualified and refusing their requested carve-outs.

This keeps you well protected while getting the deal closed on the end-March timetable. Happy to discuss, but if you're content we'll put it to Hargrove as a package.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Approved. We're comfortable at a 75% cap and 15 months' survival, and 18 months on the non-compete is fine. Agreed on 17.5% / GBP 150k. And yes - hold the MAC. We're not giving up the walk-away right on a deal this size. Put it to them.

Margaret

Margaret Holloway | Partner | Crestview Capital Partners
